notes.title: v1.0.0f1 – Bugfix Update
notes.content:
[b]Changed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rotation speed of the Laser
[*] Slowdown effect on certain entities when hit by the laser (gnome)
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] LaserGun not reloading when firing with an empty magazine
[*] Grappling hook pulling the player into walls
[*] USO glitch when digging while falling
[*] Sound stutter and single loud playback when loading assets
[/list]
